modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 11 parts (395,328 triangles, three 2048 px textures: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map), standing in an A-pose. UV seams welded and each part decimated, the head keeping relatively more detail, to 19,988 triangles in 11 parts (remake/tools/blender-decimate.py ... parts, Blender 5.2; kept as source/egill-parts.glb). Baked by remake/tools/bake/bake-biped.js (run with bake-character.mjs): stood on the ground, scaled from 0.98 m to 1.1 m and turned to face +X, rigged with 20 humanoid bones placed from the seams between the parts, smooth skin weights, seven clips authored in code (biped-clips.js), merged into one skinned mesh with one matte single-sided material (roughness 0.65, no metalness, normal map at 0.6), base colour and normal map as 1024 px JPEG, the metal/roughness map dropped.
rig: Our bake tool (plan decision 5 changed to 'Bökunartólið, tvífætt'). Bones: root, Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Left/Right Shoulder, UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand, Left/Right UpperLeg, LowerLeg, Foot; identity rest rotations. Clips: idle 3.2 s, walk 0.95 s, wave and waveLeft 2.4 s, point 2.0 s, sit 3.2 s (riding), lifted 1.6 s.
